scope: One typed continuation planner now drives ordinary CPU task LLVM emission and mixed CPU/GPU C++ supervisor emission.

semantics.plan: Typed slots, groups, calls, selectors, transfers, spawn/await, expected errors, recovery, fields and explicit branch/settlement edges.
semantics.policies: CPU compilation retains helper expansion and numeric kernel extraction. Mixed compilation preserves synchronous calls and selects main; function IDs retain their original positions.
semantics.ownership: Existing scheduler, captures, immutable Buffer leases, fault isolation and resource/cancellation cleanup remain in use.
semantics.settlement: Group-directed failure edges go through close/join. Metal separates close from resumable join; failed admission jumps to owning settlement and preserves its error.
semantics.shapes: Target-proven shape facts survive straight-line payload flow; branch writes meet shape facts instead of selecting the last arm. Public CPU ABI dynamic result contracts stay dynamic.
semantics.constants: Preserved constant tensor data is embedded, not expanded into one continuation slot per element; nonconstant operands retain their order.
semantics.limits: Original CPU expansion/recursion and per-frame value limits remain. Unsupported placed IR cannot silently enter the CPU emitter.
semantics.inspection: Standalone --dump-plan equals target continuation.plan for 70 fixtures; option/preflight validation retained.
semantics.lifetime: ModulePlan references immutable checked input through target emission; factory returns no partial plan on failure.
semantics.remaining: Resumable mixed helper bodies, broader values/element types, more devices and native distributed execution are not implemented by this increment.

additional_planner_cases: 21000-element constant tensor fits fewer than 20 plan slots
coverage: CPU task execution and helper expansion
Mixed pipelines, tensors and shape guards
Known mismatch after transitive shape-preserving GPU helpers rejects transactionally
qualification.private_observation: GPU await sites and lexical group access are emitted from plan positions; lifecycle tests no longer depend on frame-field/program-counter literals.
qualification.compiler_instrumentation: Sanitized compiler emits identical mixed host/CPU/GPU/typed IR/continuation plan artifacts.

changed_cpu_wrapper_lowering.reason: Scalar supervisor unary arithmetic uses exact sign-bit operations; redundant scalar negation wrappers disappear in host-expression programs and their dynamic/signed-zero probes. Core CPU tensor lowering and recorded GPU numerical artifacts are unchanged.

distributed_execution: Not implemented; design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Compiler architecture/correctness integration; no speedup claim.
